newsitem.title: GERMANY: Continental 1996 group net profit up 24 pct.
newsitem.headline: Continental 1996 group net profit up 24 pct.

text.p: German tyre-maker Continental AG said on Monday that its 1996 group net profits rose 24 percent to 192.5 million marks, on turnover up 1.7 percent at 10.4 billion marks.
Profits before tax and interest charges in the same period grew by 35.2 percent to 524.1 million marks, Continental AG said after a meeting of its supervisory board.
The group said it would propose a dividend of 60 pfennigs per five mark share, up from 50 pfennigs last time, which amounts to a total dividend payout of 56.7 million marks, up from 47 million marks.
